verdict.rationale: Tailscale documents Tailscale SSH for managing authentication and authorization of SSH connections, and users report SSH'ing into remote boxes and Raspberry Pis over their tailnet. However, nothing in the evidence addresses SSH key-based authentication or which key types are supported. Missing for 10: any evidence of Ed25519, ECDSA, or RSA key support; documentation of how standard SSH key auth works over or alongside Tailscale SSH; hands-on corroboration of key-type compatibility.
